notes: Stops the Management tile landing being pulled back to the top on Android/mobile. The top-level Management tab no longer runs the underlying full Reports render; the tile landing is activated directly. While that landing is visible, legacy programmatic scrollTo/scroll/scrollIntoView calls are ignored and unexpected non-user upward layout jumps are restored to the user's last position. Manual touch/wheel/key scrolling remains normal. Adds overflow-anchor protection. Detail Reports/Calendar/Knowledge screens retain their normal scrolling. No database change.
